overall_assessment: Section splitting is largely correct: learning_outcomes, teaching_methods, coursework_requirements (obligatory activity correctly kept out of assessment), prerequisites and reading_list are accurate and complete in all 20 courses. The defects are scraping cruft: a semester-picker widget wrapped around every course_content row, and an exam-logistics table plus semester fragments appended to assessment. All 14 suspects were flagged only 'boilerplate' for identical text across TYSDI offerings, which is a false alarm.

findings.evidence: Vel emnebeskrivelse for semester (Neste semester) (Noverande semester) (Forrige semester)
findings.description: Every course_content row (20 of 20) begins with the page's semester-picker widget text and ends with a second copy prefixed with '>'. For short plans such as TYSDI the widget is about as long as the real 'Mål og innhold' text. The row is not clean per the rubric, and the picker text is identical across courses, so it also inflates duplicate and similarity measures.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The details_uib strategy (R/extract_sections.R, extract_sections_uib) takes the h2/intro block for Mål og innhold including the semester dropdown component, and .clean_sections() does not strip it. The widget is absent from the anonymized course_plan, so it is added by the section extractor's own DOM walk.
findings.suggested_fix: In extract_sections_uib() or .clean_sections(), drop lines matching '^>?\s*Vel emnebeskrivelse for semester' and the following '(Neste semester) (Noverande semester) (Forrige semester)' line. Better, exclude the picker element via section_intro_selector in R/institution_config.R.

findings.evidence: Vurderingsordning Mappevurdering Innleveringsfrist , Trekkfrist Eksamenssystem Inspera Digital eksamen
findings.description: Where the page has an exam-information table, the assessment row ends with exam logistics: Vurderingsordning, Innleveringsfrist, Trekkfrist, Eksamenssystem/Inspera, Dato, Varigheit, and in NORAN204 even the room ('Sted Solheimsgt. 18 (Administrasjonsbygget) , SOL 2. etg.') and a clock-time notice. RELV105 gets 'Andre opplysninger Eksamen i uke 23'. The table values (dates) are empty, so only labels remain. Per the recipe, exam-logistics tables do not belong in assessment. The real assessment text is correct and complete before them.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The exam table is a sibling block following the Vurderingsformer details element and is appended to assessment; no heading in R/section_heading_map.R terminates it.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() for uib, cut the assessment text at the first line matching '^Vurderingsordning$', and also remove 'Klokkeslett for oppstart av skriftlig eksamen ...' and 'Andre opplysninger' blocks.

findings.evidence: Vår. Der er òg vurdering tidleg i haustsemesteret for studentar med gyldig godkjenning av obligatoriske arbeidskrav.
findings.description: The Vurderingssemester value is appended to assessment as a stray fragment ('Vår og haust', 'Haust. Der er òg vurdering tidleg i vårsemesteret ...'). It is administrative scheduling, not assessment, and the fragment begins with the season word that the anonymized plan has removed (plan shows only '. Der er òg vurdering ...'), so the sections text and course_plan disagree.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Vurderingssemester' has no entry in R/section_heading_map.R (or is not a drop section), so its body is attached to the preceding assessment section.
findings.suggested_fix: Map the 'Vurderingssemester' heading to a dropped section in R/section_heading_map.R so its content is discarded, or strip the line in .clean_sections().

findings.evidence: Studentane evaluerer undervisninga ved slutten av semesteret i tråd med fastsette prosedyrar for undervisningsevaluering.
findings.description: In 2016-2018 TYSDI plans the course-evaluation sentence is part of the Vurderingsformer text on the page and is carried into assessment. Course evaluation is not assessment of students.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Source page puts the sentence in the Vurderingsformer paragraph block, so no heading boundary exists.
findings.suggested_fix: Strip sentences beginning 'Studentane evaluerer undervisninga' from assessment in .clean_sections().

findings.evidence: Hausten 2020 blir munnleg eksamen digital, som tiltak mot spreiing av koronavirus.
findings.description: The plan's Vurderingsformer ends with this sentence about the digital oral exam, but the assessment row stops after 'Nærare retningsliner for oppgåvene vert gitt i studiet.' and then jumps to the Vurderingssemester fragment, so the final paragraph is lost.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Likely a paragraph-level dedup or a cut at the last paragraph in the uib Vurderingsformer handler (extract_sections_uib), possibly treating the final paragraph as a duplicate or term-specific note.
findings.suggested_fix: Check extract_sections_uib() for dropping of year-specific trailing paragraphs; keep all paragraphs inside the Vurderingsformer details body.

findings.evidence: Pensum utgjer omlag 350 sider av normal vanskegrad.
findings.description: Pre-pass 'boilerplate' flags on prerequisites, teaching_methods, coursework_requirements, reading_list, course_content and learning_outcomes for the TYSDI courses are false alarms: the text is genuine content that is identical across offerings of the same course. The 20 random and suspect courses show these sections landing correctly, and recommended-prerequisites text within prerequisites is consistent with the codebook.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Pre-pass counts identical text across at least 25 courses, which fires for multiple offerings of one course.
findings.suggested_fix: In R/audit/qa_sections.R, count the boilerplate flag over distinct course codes rather than course offerings.
